description: Domestic 10-K/10-KT primary-document acquisition queue over frozen FRAME_v1 (ADR-095). Derived from the carrier, not estimated from firm counts: 8,718 carrier rows over 8,526 unique accessions, so 17,052 requests at two per accession, and 8,526 fetches serve 8,718 rows because 134 shared accessions cover 326 rows. At shard_size 100 that is 86 shards. The per-accession allowance is a bound and not a prediction: 12 MiB is roughly twice the largest primary ever observed (6,499,830 bytes over 18 measured accessions), and a shard that legitimately exceeds its budget fails closed and must be re-planned under a new plan hash. The four shell-canary exclusions do not reduce this queue: determinations exist for 23 rows only and cannot exist before acquisition. Possessing this definition authorizes no request; execution requires an operator-named shard allowlist.

route_validation.note: URL-route grammar only, proven for the probe's own three accessions; never selection evidence for any firm in this queue.

deferred_cohorts.reason: Preserved by frozen FRAME_v1 and the carrier, and deliberately deferred: the acquisition form enum admits 10-K/10-KT only and FPI cover-page structure has never been measured here. Deferred, not excluded.
